title: Why Can't You Play GTA 6 on PC Yet?
description:
GTA 6 came out on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. PC players got nothing. But this isn't new: GTA 5 reached consoles in 2013 and PC only in 2015. Red Dead Redemption 2 came to consoles in 2018 and to PC a year later. Take-Two's CEO says Rockstar always starts on console, to serve its core players first. One report says GTA 6 could reach PC in early 2027, but nothing is official yet.

Are you still waiting for GTA 6 on PC?

More true whys: https://www.youtube.com/@truewhys?sub_confirmation=1

Sources: Rockstar Newswire; Bloomberg interview with Strauss Zelnick (via Dork, Vice); GamesBeat report (via HuffPost UK); TechRadar and GameSpot (RDR2 PC date).
